decisions.rationale: Rotom Thunderbolt is guaranteed OHKO (105-382%) vs Pelipper 15% and moves before Pelipper (226 vs 85-117). Arcanine Extreme Speed +2 gives second KO chance and goes first. If Pelipper Protects, both blocked but Pelipper does not attack, so Arcanine stays safe; next turn Protect odds drop further. If Pelipper attacks, Rotom KOs before Hydro Pump hits.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Pelipper LO Modest Drizzle Hurricane/Hydro/U-turn/Protect, Aegislash Bold Leftovers KingShield/ShadowBall/FlashCannon/Protect, Volc Sash Modest QD/FireBlast/BugBuzz/Protect, Mega Medicham Adamant PurePower CC/PsychoCut/FakeOut/Protect, Gyara Sitrus Intim Jolly Waterfall/EQ/DD/Protect, G-Stunfisk BlackBelt Adamant EQ/SR/TWave/Protect. Our plan: Rotom Scarf Levitate immune EQ, Arcanine Intim/Wisp vs physical, Garchomp LO Rock Slide vs flying. Preserve priority for low HP.

reflections.summary: Lost because Rotom-Mow (Choice Scarf Thunderbolt, Levitate) outspeeds and 4x OHKOs Pelipper, destroying rain and leaving no safe pivot; Arcanine’s Intimidate + Extreme Speed and Garchomp’s spread damage then dismantled our Protect-reliant core. The preview of Pelipper/Aegislash/Volcarona/Medicham-Mega was wrong for this opponent—Pelipper was dead weight and Mega-evolving Medicham yielded no value.
reflections.adjustment: Game 2: drop Pelipper from the four and do not Mega-evolve Medicham (or replace that slot); bring an Electric-resistant/ground-immune pivot that can absorb Thunderbolt and check Arcanine, abandoning the Protect-chain/rain plan for direct offensive pressure.
reflections.notebook: Opponent durable tendencies: Rotom-Mow Choice Scarf Thunderbolt (Levitate, outspeeds 152 Speed, Choice-locked into Thunderbolt), Arcanine Intimidate + Extreme Speed + Flare Blitz + Sitrus Berry, Garchomp Life Orb Rough Skin with Earthquake/Rock Slide spread, Sneasler Unburden Focus Sash (Close Combat/Gunk Shot). Unused by opponent: Dragonite (Tailwind/ExtremeSpeed/Earthquake/Lum Berry), Houndstone (LastRespects/PhantomForce/Will-O-Wisp/Leftovers). Revealed strategic facts: Rain + Protect chain collapses against Scarf Electric plus priority; Medichamite Mega evolution contributed nothing. Future plan: never preview Pelipper if Rotom-Mow is likely; reserve Mega Stone only if the holder actually answers Rotom/Arcanine; for game 2 prioritize a Thunderbolt-absorbing partner and an Arcanine check over stalling.

reflections.summary: Won game 1 because Arcanine Intimidate entry + Rotom-Mow Scarf Thunderbolt/Extreme Speed core beat opponent's double Protect/King's Shield stall. Garchomp Rock Slide chipped Aegislash despite Protects, then Arcanine Flare Blitz (super-effective vs Aegislash) + Rotom Thunderbolt removed Volcarona/Aegislash, and priority + Electric cleaned 15% Pelipper rain setter. Team-preview of Arcanine/Rotom/Garchomp/Sneasler covered Pelipper/Volc/Aegislash/Mega-Medicham without needing our own Mega.
reflections.adjustment: Next game expect Gyarados and G-Stunfisk to answer Rotom/Arcanine. Lead Arcanine+Rotom to pressure Pelipper rain and DD Gyara immediately, keep Rotom Trick ready for Volc/Aegislash setup instead of early Thunderbolt lock, and preserve Sneasler Fake Out for Mega Medicham. Don't overcommit Garchomp into Bug Buzz/King's Shield 50/50s.
reflections.notebook: Opp tendencies: heavy Protect stall - Aegislash spams King's Shield (8 uses) + Volcarona Protect to waste turns, Pelipper brought late at low HP to reset Rain and Protect stall. Mega Medicham played early aggressive and fainted before turn 6. Did not bring Gyara/Stunfisk G1, likely to bring G2 to counter Rotom/Arcanine. Our durable plan: Rotom Scarf Levitate still key vs Pelipper/Gyara and EQ immunity, Arcanine Intim + ESpeed for low-HP cleanup, preserve Trick vs QD/DD. Keep Fake Out + priority for Medicham.
